PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: location-hells-inner-chamber-the-prison-cavern-light-transformation
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Location guard: transfer only color, light behavior, haze, scale language, and material realism. Do not copy the reference cave, Hell gate, fortress geometry, crowds, or blocking unless this row explicitly requires those elements.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain; explicitly requested golden luminous-VFX behavior only.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
HELL'S INNER CHAMBER - THE PRISON CAVERN — LIGHT TRANSFORMATION: CINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT, SCALE, LIGHTING, MATERIALS, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic epic ultra-wide establishing production still of Hell's inner prison chamber mid-transformation after the Harrower's shockwave, the exact screenplay beat where the cavern collapses not into ruin but into redemption. Massive subterranean cathedral volume roughly five hundred feet long by four hundred feet wide under a three-hundred-foot ceiling that is lifting from smoke into luminous haze. Forty-eight colossal structural pillars march in solemn rows through the chamber; nearest pillars crack and shear as black basalt and obsidian faceplates convert in a rolling wave into pure polished white marble veined with soft gold, stone grains reorienting as if polished by invisible hands, surfaces catching warm specular highlights where divine light first arrives.

Divine golden radiance floods inward through the shattered fortress-gate aperture at the far end of the hall, the breach still framed by iron-and-bone debris and fractured lintel, yet the gate itself is no longer the subject—only the mouth through which pure white-gold god rays pour. Volumetric shafts of ethereal gold (#FFD700) and warm amber (#FFBF00) cut diagonally through residual black smoke and ash, resolving poison fog into perfume-like warm amber atmosphere. Where those rays strike floor and pillar, temperature and material flip: cold blue hell-torch flame (~2000K royal-blue cores, #4169E1) mid-transmutation into golden fire with soft white cores; torch brackets and wall sconces glow from within as metal corrosion brightens toward burnished bronze. Ceiling smoke parts along the beam axes, revealing fractured stone vaults bleaching toward marble.

Across the chamber, the vast chain grid that once suspended ten thousand pale thin souls is failing all at once. Corroded iron links, bloodstained and heavy with centuries, snap midair and cascade to the floor in glittering arcs of falling metal; broken chains hang limp from pillar rings and wall sockets, others already heaped on marble-whitening flagstones. Freed righteous souls stand and kneel in shallow staggered planes through middle and deep distance—pale bodies rewarming under amber light, rough earth-tone linens and worn shepherd cloths catching translucency at sleeve edges, faces lifted toward the light with tears and impossible hope rather than torment. Bodies remain anatomically correct, thin from long waiting but upright now; no gore, no modern clothing. Midground silhouettes suggest ancient patriarchs and prophets among the throng (staff, broken harp outline, animal skins) without readable insignia or text, only period materials and reverent bearing.

Floor plane shows the shockwave's geometry: radial hairline fractures racing outward from a central impact zone where pure golden light still blooms, stone plates tilting then settling as basalt becomes white marble. A staircase of pure white and gold light has begun to open upward through a new breach in the upper vault—luminous steps of solid radiance ascending toward heaven, edges soft with bloom, stairs not stone but condensed light thick enough to walk. Residual red underglow of hell (~3500K) lingers only in farthest corners and behind farthest pillars, retreating before the advancing warm key so the composition reads as a living frontier of transformation rather than pure darkness or full dawn already finished.

Camera: anamorphic 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen, approximately 24–28mm wide lens from a slightly elevated three-quarter vantage near one side aisle, deep focus through the full depth of the hall so gate flood, transforming pillars, chain fall, soul throng, and ascending light stair all read in one frame. Low haze and ash motes sparkle inside the god rays; subtle lens bloom on the brightest shafts without digital glare artifacts. Color grade follows the divine-intrusion master arc: ethereal golds, warm amber, pure white radiance ~6500K on the invading light; residual deep crimson (#8B0000) and obsidian black (#0A0A0A) only where hell has not yet yielded; blue torch remnants mid-shift to gold. Atmosphere: dust and ash becoming perfume particulate, soft warmth replacing cold damp, no fog completely erasing architecture.

Photoreal live-action biblical epic production reference, IMAX-grade scale, physically coherent material transitions, sacred reverent tone not horror exploitation. Continuity locks: hell torches blue only until this transformation then gold; black stone becomes white marble; chains breaking mass-release not sequential single snaps; staircase of light opening upward; gate breach as light source at far end; no modern objects, no logos, no captions, no watermarks, no UI, no readable text or signage carved into stone, no anachronistic fixtures. Single coherent moment of mid-to-late transformation—half the chamber still scarred night, half already sanctuary—so the eye understands the miracle in progress.
